integrity: The classification is proved directly from closed-neighborhood traces and independently stress-tested on 58 finite profiles; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only chain graphs whose canonical open-neighborhood twin classes all have size at least 2 are covered.
The finite verifier is corroborative and is not used as an infinite proof.
Poorly indexed literature under alternative terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: All identifying codes of thick chain graphs
